# Apex Works

Apex Works is based in Monroe, Washington. We do website audits for Washington businesses. We also help with Google search and with AI optimization, so tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI answers can recommend a business.

We work with local businesses and service-area businesses across Washington. A business can get help even if it works from home and does not publish a street address.

Contact: damon@theapexworks.com
Website: https://theapexworks.com

## Apex Site Snapshot

The Apex Site Snapshot is a one-time $499 website audit for Washington local businesses. There is no monthly plan. Checkout is at https://buy.stripe.com/cNieVf0KFcYJffUfBQcMM00 and the page is https://theapexworks.com/snapshot.

What you get:
- A plain-English score of your website and Google presence
- Top fixes, ranked by what brings in the most calls
- A check on whether AI tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI answers can recommend you
- A 20-minute Zoom walkthrough
- Step-by-step instructions for your web person, or we can make the changes for you

Your report arrives in about 48 hours after payment.

## How it works

1. Buy the Snapshot. You pay $499 once.
2. We write the report. It arrives in about 48 hours after payment.
3. We walk you through it on a 20-minute Zoom.
4. You get the fixes as step-by-step instructions, or we can make the changes for you.

## FAQ

What's in the Snapshot?
A plain-English score of your website and Google presence, top fixes ranked by what brings in the most calls, a check on whether AI tools like ChatGPT and Google's AI answers can recommend you, a 20-minute Zoom walkthrough, and step-by-step instructions for your web person, or we can make the changes for you.

How long does it take?
Your report arrives in about 48 hours after payment.

Do I need a web person?
No. The instructions are written so anyone can hand them off, or we can make the changes for you.

I work from home and don't list my address. Can you still help?
Yes. We cover service-area businesses and how to show up on Google without publishing a street address.

What happens after I pay?
You'll get an email to schedule the walkthrough. For refund questions, email damon@theapexworks.com.
